description: The lessons check, as a nudge. In a repo whose PLAYBOOK.md has '## The lessons check', an edit, a git commit or a git push is denied until Claude has written a visible 'Lessons checked:' line in this turn (a background task's notification carries on the turn before it), after its last commit or push, and, in the session's own repo, where its dev/lessons.mjs is this plugin's version, run a lookup with it. In other repos it does nothing. It reads the target repo's PLAYBOOK.md and dev/lessons.mjs and the session transcript, writes nothing and starts no program. Any error lets the call through. LESSONS_GATE=off turns it off.
